Titles.jpn: あにトレ！EX

Summaries.eng: "Move your soul and body!" Each episode contains a variety of routines, such as push-ups, sit-ups, spine twists, dance, yoga, stretches, trunk training, and taichi. Five girls aiming to become idols will exercise with you, and that troubling body fat percentage will go down by 1000%...!?
Summaries.jpn:
主観目線で一緒にエクササイズ！
燃焼系TVアニメ

Aliases: Anitore! XX: Hitotsu Yane no Shita de

Titles.eng: Let's Exercise with a Jump Rope, desu wa!
Now! Begin the Dance of Sit-ups!
Let Us Begin the Wide Squats!

Summaries.eng: "Move your soul and body!" Each episode contains a variety of routines, such as push-ups, sit-ups, spine twists, dance, yoga, stretches, trunk training, and taichi. Five girls aiming to become idols will exercise with you, and that troubling body fat percentage will go down by 1000%...!?

Titles.eng: Push-up and Sit-ups! Bring it On!!
Titles.jpn: 腕立て腹筋！ばっちこーい！

Summaries.eng: Asami Hoshi teaches the viewers the push-ups and crunches, and hopes that she can eat a soft served ice cream.
Summaries.jpn:
筋トレといえば、まず思い浮かべるのは【腕立て】と【腹筋】。
大好きなソフトクリームを罪悪感なく食べたい…
そんな思いを胸に、あさみはトレーニングをスタートさせる！

Titles.eng: More Push-ups! Because it's For Breast Enlargement!!
Titles.jpn: もっと腕立て！バストアップなんだから!!

Summaries.eng: Eri Higuchi, despite getting annoyed about her breast size that she tried to work on, teaches the viewers the Hindu and Reverse Push-ups.
Summaries.jpn:
カワイイ水着を着るために、女の子は陰で努力をしているのです。
スタイルアップ＆バストアップ…えりがチャレンジする一石二鳥の【腕立て】トレーニングとは？

Titles.eng: Back Extension Squats! Aiming for Classical Japan Feminine Virtues!!
Titles.jpn: 背筋スクワット！　目指せ大和撫子ですわ!!

Summaries.eng: Shizuno Saotome, after finishing with her cooking, teaches the viewers the squats and back extension, before they can all enjoy her food.
Summaries.jpn:
静乃が手作り料理でおもてなし。その前にいい汗かけば、おいしさもアップするかも！？
キング・オブ・エクササイズ【スクワット】で、めざせこぶりヒップ！

Titles.eng: Descent of the False God! Guide Me, Darkness!
Titles.jpn: 邪神降臨舞踏！闇よ、我を導き給へ!!

Summaries.eng: Shion Tachibana, thinking that she's a "fallen angel from the world of Denebrae", teaches the viewers the "Dance of the Void" and "Dance of the Wicked", which are known as the "Bow Pose" and "Camel Pose", two poses from Yoga.
Summaries.jpn:
漆黒の闇世界テネブラエより降臨せし堕天使、紫苑。
さあ光あふれる世界の民よ…邪に満ちし闇の（ヨ ガ）舞いを踊るのだ。
【弓のポーズ】と【らくだのポーズ】で深遠なる闇に身を委ねよ…！

Titles.jpn: レッツ・ダンシング！　汗をかいてキラリキラ!!

Summaries.eng: Asami, Eri, and Shizuno teach the viewers on how to do the "Vital Exercise" dance. During the lesson, Eri suggested to name that dance company for themselves as "Eri with Dancing Flowers".
Summaries.jpn:
今回は「ばいたる☆エクササイズ」をしっかり練習するよ！
あさみ・えり・静乃は三人で合同レッスン。
えりの提案でダンスユニット名を決めることにしたんだけど…。

Titles.jpn: キック＆ツイスト！　いっぱい頑張るですぅ!!

Summaries.eng: Yū Hiraoka had trouble falling asleep, so she, while teaching the viewers, does the Back Kick and the Reverse Trunk Twist exercises in order for her to go to sleep.
Summaries.jpn:
最近眠りが浅いともじもじしている優。
心身共にリラックスしてぐっすり快眠をするために
【バックキック】【リバーストランクツイスト】で筋トレをすることに！

Titles.eng: Tough Push-ups and Squats! Don't Give Up!
Titles.jpn: ハードに腕立てスクワット！　負けないもん!!

Summaries.eng: Asami and Eri teach the viewers the clapping push-ups and the Hindu squats. During the lesson, Eri still gets annoyed about her breast size and thinks it's a competition between her and Asami.
Summaries.jpn:
あさみの部屋に遊びに来たえり。
「あさみっちには負けないんだから！」と燃えるえりに
「ライバルだって思ってくれてる？嬉しい…」とまんざらでもないあさみ。
今回は【クラッピングプッシュアップ】と【ヒンズースクワット】で気になるアノ部分を鍛えます♡

Titles.jpn: モア・ダンシング！　笑顔で美デトックス!!

Summaries.eng: Asami, Shion, and Yū teach the viewers the "Vital Exercise" dance, again. Afterwards, Asami decided that they should go to the store to buy the soft served ice creams, while learning that Shion works there and her real name is "Akiko", much to Shion's denial.
Summaries.jpn:
暗黒の邪心を讃える舞（ばいたる☆エクササイズ）を踊るため、
アサミール（あさみ）とユウメルアール（優）と共に、紫苑は禁断の領域へと歩を進めてゆく…！

Titles.jpn: 伸び伸びストレッチ！　魅惑のプールサイド

Summaries.eng: Eri arrived at Shizuno's indoor pool, but before she can race in a pool, Shizuno suggested that they should do the warm-up exercises, by teaching the viewers on how to stretch the outer sides of bodies, the shoulders, and the lower bodies.
Summaries.jpn:
今回は早乙女家にある豪華な屋内プールで水着ストレッチ。
健康的な美しさを保つために、ヒザや肩、肩甲骨をのびのびしちゃいます！

Titles.eng: Let's Go to the Gym! Fun Exercises!
Titles.jpn: Let’s Go スポーツジム！　楽しくエクササイズ

Summaries.eng: Asami and Yū have arrived at the sports gym, but when Yū is unsure if she can do it, Asami helps her out, by teaching her, and the viewers, on how to lift weights in the butterfly machine, work on the Synchro machine, work on the leg press, and work on the adduction and abduction machines.
Summaries.jpn:
今日はフィットネスクラブでトレーニング！
なかなか敷居が高そうだけど…いろんなマシンがあって好きなメニューを選べちゃうのが魅力的♪
さあ、あなたもちょっぴり勇気を出してみて♪

Titles.eng: Easy Tai Chi! Core Strength Training!
Titles.jpn: ゆったり太極拳！　体幹、鍛えるんだから

Summaries.eng: Shion, Eri, and Yū teach the viewers Tai Chi, while Shion thinks they're performing the "Dance of Resurrection". During the lesson, Eri encourages Yū how she can make her dreams come true. After the lesson ends, Asami and Shizuno arrived. Asami and her friends thanked the viewers for keeping up with them, but they are not done yet.
Summaries.jpn:
暗黒の大神官復活の舞…
なんていつものモードに入ってる紫苑に呆れるえり。
ダンスのつもりが今回は全員で太極拳になっちゃった！？
さて、アイドルの卵たちはどんな演舞を見せてくれるのか…？

Titles.jpn: ばいたる☆エクササイズ！もっと笑顔!!

Summaries.eng: The girls will now perform the "Vital Exercise" dance, with the viewers dancing along. During the dance, scenes from the past episodes are shown.
Summaries.jpn:
みんなで「ばいたる☆エクササイズ」を踊ってみた！
さあいよいよ集大成、みんなで一緒にエクササイズしよう！

Summaries.eng:
Sequel of Anitore! EX.

New member Sakura Izumi joins the five idol candidates of the previous season. A second year middle schooler, she often wears a big smile on her face.

Titles.jpn: いざゆけ新XX!レッツお掃除＆サイドベンド

Summaries.eng: Asami, Eri, Yū, Shizuno, and Shion are all cleaning up the new apartment "Bonheur Chateau", with the viewers helping out, in order to start their new lives together. During their clean-up time, Asami teaches the viewers the lateral side bend exercise in the lesson room. Then, a mysterious new girl arrives in front of the apartment.

Titles.eng: Running XX Train!? Training Anytime, Anywhere
Titles.jpn: 走るXX電車!?いつでもどこでもトレーニング

Summaries.eng: Eri, while heading for school, teaches the viewers the invisible chair and calf raises, in a train. Afterwards, she introduces them her friend, who thinks Eri and the viewers are a couple. Soon after, they unexpectedly encounter Shion, who is working at her station while trying to hide her secret from them.

Titles.eng: Spin! Spin! Mat Exercises, All the Way
Titles.jpn: 回れ回れ、マット・エクササイズ！XXあるのみですわ

Summaries.eng: Shizuno helps Yū do the Mat Exercises, while they both teach the viewers the two kinds of Mat Exercises: The Somersault and the Somersault Splits, in order for Yū to do well in her Mat Exercise Test on the next day.

Titles.jpn: 悦楽なる闇のXX!終焉の始まりし時

Summaries.eng: Shion teaches the viewers the Supine Hip Lift and the Sit-ups, while trying to make them believe that she doesn't work at the station, even though she does. Soon after, she gets her message from her mother, and when her mother arrives, she gives the pizza that she bought to the viewers, to give to Shion, much to Shion's dismay.

Titles.eng: XX Stretch Out and Aim for the Top Swimmer
Titles.jpn: レッツ柔軟！XXほぐして、目指せトップスイマー

Summaries.eng: Back in Shizuno's indoor pool, Asami was about to train for her swimming competition at school, until Shizuno suggested that she needs to do her warm-up stretches. Shizuno then helps Asami warm-up, while they both teach the viewers how to stretch by doing the front and back bends, the invisible chair stretches, and the leg raise stretches.

Titles.eng: Shape Up on the Balance Ball, I Dub Thee My XX
Titles.jpn: バランスボールでシェイプアップ！余のXXと認めよう

Summaries.eng: Sakura Izumi, the new girl from before and who thinks she is an emperor from "The Sakura Empire", teaches the viewers, while treating them as her "noble steed", the Ball Sit-ups and the Wide Squats, even though she tried to cheat her way out of those exercises.

Titles.eng: Jogging for Breezy Aerobics! XX Feels Great
Titles.jpn: ジョギングでさわやか有酸素！XXって気持ちいいね

Summaries.eng: Asami and Eri teach the viewers how to jog, and during the jogging montage, one policewoman, three little girls, and a cat all jog along after Asami and Eri stopped by. Soon after, Asami, Eri, and the rest of the girls enjoy their bath time, while Eri gets more jealous when she notices that Asami's breasts grew a little more bigger.

Titles.jpn: マッサージでリラックス！一緒にXXしましょう

Summaries.eng: After witnessing that Yū was jogging like Asami and Eri did, Shion massages her leg to relax. Then, Sakura appeared, and while teaching and massaging the viewers, Sakura and Shion fought over Yū. When the other girls arrived to see them fighting, Yū was left no choice but to play along and becomes an evil wizard, apparently.

Titles.jpn: なわとびでポッカポカ！カラダだけでなく、XXも…

Summaries.eng: Shizuno teaches the viewers how to warm up by rope skipping, both normally and crisscrossing. During the exercise, she talked about her life and having fun exercising with her friends. After they finished warming up, and Andalucía tied Shizuno up and made her fall on the viewers, they all enjoy the tea made by Shizuno.

Titles.eng: Fix Your Worries with Push Ups and Back Muscle Exercises
Titles.jpn: 腕立て＆背筋でお悩み解消！がんばってXXいれてみます

Summaries.eng: Yū was concerned about using her contact lenses rather than her glasses, so in order to relax, she does, while teaching the viewers, the Unilateral Push-ups and the Prawn Back Extension. Afterwards, she accidentally bumped into Shion, making Yū drop her contact lenses, which are broken accidentally by Sakura soon after.

Titles.eng: Tighten Up Your Upper Arms with Dumbbells
Titles.jpn: ダンベルで二の腕スッキリ！魅惑のXXが待ってるよ

Summaries.eng: Asami teaches the viewers how to work out with dumbbells. Soon after, a Christmas party is coming up, and Asami got something to say to the viewers for later. However, she is not the only one, because Eri, Sakura, Shizuno, Shion, and Yū have all got something to say to the viewers as well.

Titles.eng: Living Together XX Is About to Begin
Titles.jpn: ひとつ屋根の下で！XXが始まる時間だよ

Summaries.eng: After the viewers helped them finished preparing for a Christmas party, the girls have confessed their own feelings for the viewers. After that, a Christmas feast has begun, and the girls all wanted the viewers to sit right next to one of them, making the viewers pass out. The series ends with Asami waking the viewers up, like in the first episode.
